text_block_list.text: After finishing training on an off-campus course, we were heading back, but...

Symboli Rudolf was standing still
in front of a display window.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...So this is what it means to sleep soundly with a high pillow and a clear conscience.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Look at this shameful display.
It seems I've grown a bit soft.
choice_data_list: I don't think it'll make much difference.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That's not true.
The skirt is stretching just a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Sitting at my desk in the student council room
for so long must have caught up with me after all..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In order to be a role model for all,
not just one's actions, but one's appearance is of great importance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We must revert this as swiftly as possible!
Sorry, Trainer, but you're coming along with me.

Afterward, the two of them worked on dieting,
and Symboli Rudolf returned
to a satisfying physique.
